description: Reads the board's latest daily probe of one server in the official MCP registry: status, how a client gets access, the exact Claude token cost of its tool definitions, tool count, latency and the most expensive tools. Instant, no connection to the server. Use it when the server is in the registry; use search_servers when you do not know its name, and check_server to probe a URL that is not in the registry. A name or URL that is not on the board returns isError with a short message.

nameOrUrl.description: The registry name, for example io.github.owner/name, or the server's https URL as the registry lists it. The name is exact; the URL must match the registry entry.

name: lookup_server

authDocumentation.description: The publisher's guide to getting access

authKind.description: How a client gets in: oauth-dcr (clients register themselves), oauth (client id from the publisher), token (a key in the Authorization header), unknown

authMetadata.description: authorizationServers, scopesSupported, dynamicRegistration, pkce, grantTypes, from the OAuth metadata

authScheme.description: The WWW-Authenticate scheme of a server that needs auth

claudeError.description: Why the Anthropic endpoint refused to count

claudeModel.description: The model the exact count is for

claudeTokens.description: Exact count from the Anthropic count_tokens endpoint, names as published

claudeTokensClaudeCode.description: The exact count with the Claude Code prefix mcp__<server>__ on each tool name

down.description: True when the server has failed for two days or more; a more recent failure is "no answer", not down

failingSince.description: For a server with no valid answer: the first probe of its current run of failed probes, ISO 8601

httpStatus.description: The HTTP status of the first response

page.description: The server's page on the board

protocolVersion.description: The MCP protocol version the server negotiated

shareOf200k.description: Percent of a 200k window, exact when claudeTokens is present

status.description: ok (answered initialize and tools/list), auth (needs credentials), payment (402), needs_url (every URL in the registry has a placeholder each user fills in; not called), unprobed (an entry the probe does not run yet: an MCPB bundle, an OCI image, a NuGet or Cargo package, or nothing to connect to), not_found, protocol_error (not MCP), timeout, dns, tls, refused, server_error, rate_limited, newer_protocol, unsupported_version (rejects the protocol version the client asks for); package servers also install_failed, no_bin, needs_env, needs_args, needs_network, needs_old_sdk (starts and lists its tools only with mcp<2), crashed. A failure counts as down only after two days of failed probes (see failingSince)

statusLabel.description: The status in words, as the board shows it

toolsTokens.description: o200k_base estimate over the compact JSON of the tool definitions; the exact count is about 1.9 times this at the median

topTools.description: The five most expensive tools: name and o200k_base tokens

title: Look up a registry server
